content.title: Kanye West’s ‘Bully’ album: tracklist, release date, use of AI update
content.text: Kanye West’s album ‘Bully’ releases on Friday, March 27th, 2026; below is a full preview of the record and its songs. Kanye West’s Bully is officially set for release on Friday, March 27th. This is Ye’s 12th solo studio album, and his first since Donda 2 in 2022. I preview the full record below. Update: 3/28/26 10:15 a.m. Kanye West officially dropped Bully on Spotify and Apple Music on Saturday morning with the below tracklist. ‘Bully’ tracklist Sisters and Brothers Whatever Works Father (feat. Travis Scott) All the Love (feat. Andre Troutman) I Can’t Wait Bully (feat. CeeLo Green) Mama’s Favorite Punch Drunk This is a Must Outside Preacher Man White Lines (feat. Andre Troutman) Circles (feat. Don Toliver) This One Here King Beauty and the Beast Damn Last Breath (feat. Peso Pluma) Project history There has been a long, complicated history when it comes to Bully. Ye announced the album all the way back in September of 2024, with plans for it to come out in the summer of 2025. He released several work-in-progress versions of songs. Sonically, they resemble some of his best production work. The beats are fantastic, but the vocals were largely samples and interpolation, with a heavy use of AI technology. According to Ye’s tweet that contained the official tracklist, no AI was used in the final cut of the album. After numerous delays between the summer of 2025 and this weekend, it seems like the album is officially set to come out. Between his break from solo music and the controversies in his personal life, fans are hoping this is Ye’s comeback record. He is one of the greatest hip-hop artists in history, and it is time for him to show what he is capable of once again. Kanye West’s ‘Bully’ album FAQ When is Kanye West’s Bully album coming out? Kanye West’s Bully album was released on Saturday, March 28th. The album is streaming on Spotify and Apple Music. What time can you begin listening to Bully? While Ye is always tough to predict, if the album drop follows traditional streaming patterns, Bully will officially be out at 9:00 p.m. PT and at 12:00 a.m. ET on March 27. Has Kanye West announced a tour for the new album? There is no official Bully tour announced as of now. However, Ye is set to perform the album over two nights in Inglewood, California on April 1st and April 3rd. The only other date on the calendar to see Kanye West live this year is at the Hellwatt Festival in Italy in July.
